comparison.objective: Slides an item onto a lift when level; candidate fractures and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Timing and planar transfer around a lift differ from small-hole coaxial tool alignment, bimanual hammering, and fragment search.
comparison.success_condition: Available evidence reports task completion but omits detailed scoring; candidate requires four physical fractures and contained fragments without insert or shell damage.
comparison.reason: The central tested ability is level-dependent transfer, not controlled notch fracture or recovery of loose metal fragments.
